name: Hash Table
description: A Hash Table is a data structure that implements an associative array, mapping keys to values. It uses a hash function to compute an index into an array of buckets, from which the desired value can be found. Hash tables provide O(1) average-case time complexity for insertions, deletions, and lookups. Collision handling is done through chaining (linked lists at each bucket).

aiExplanation.content: A Hash Table provides O(1) average-case time complexity for insertions, deletions, and lookups by using a hash function to map keys to array indices. Collisions (when two keys hash to the same index) are handled through chaining - storing multiple key-value pairs in a linked list at each bucket. Hash tables are fundamental to implementing dictionaries, caches, and database indexing.
